$comment: Source of truth for .coderails/workflow.config.yaml. status: enforced_by_code | read_by_prose_only | unused. control:true marks a safety switch whose on_value an empty config must resolve to; blocked_on names the owner of any control that is not yet ON by default. Generated key table in docs/REFERENCE.md is rendered from this file (scripts/lib/config_schema_docs.py).

project.description: Project name written by /coderails:init; read by command prose only.

wiki_path.description: LLM wiki vault directory (relative to the project dir, or absolute). null disables the wiki gate and the wiki-debt merge gate.

wiki_stale_days.description: Page age in days before wiki-lint considers staleness; age alone does not mark a page stale.

wiki_supervision.description: wiki-ingest mode: discuss (pause before writing) or autonomous.

wiki_git_worktree.description: true = PR flow for wiki commits; false = commit directly to the vault.

wiki_git_bypass_flag.description: Env var set when creating or merging the wiki's own PRs, for example BYPASS_REVIEW=1.

wiki_git_pull_path.description: Source repo pulled after a wiki PR merges.

wiki_debt_epoch_pr.description: First PR number the wiki-ingest debt merge gate covers; absent or empty disables the gate. A literal null is rejected as a bad type, as before.

worktree_script.description: Project script that creates a worktree.

jira.description: Jira settings (project, epic, component_name, component_id, epic_field, points_field, fix_version, mcp_namespace, transitions). Nested keys are not type-checked.

engineering_principles_paths.description: Glob patterns that trigger the engineering-principles pre-flight in /coderails:push.

engineering_principles_skill.description: Slash command run by the pre-flight; null skips it.

sandbox_workers.description: Default ON. Claude graph_dispatch.plan() reports sandboxed or in-process-fallback:<reason> for U3 nodes, and the Claude worker launcher consumes that mode. Codex native workers inherit the parent session sandbox; this setting does not configure or prove per-worker Codex containment.

subagent_identity_gate.description: on (default) denies an untyped Bash subagent in a graph-bound Claude session; off disables that hook.

action_authority.description: enforce (default, also with no config or no key) = gh pr merge, scripts/merge.py and git push to main/master need an owner-signed single-use receipt and honour the session authority; advisory = trace and warn only; off = switch the gate off.

diff_manifest.description: off | advisory | enforce, read by scripts/push.py and scripts/merge.py. Default enforce but inert until diff_manifest_policy names a policy file (the default policy is a Phase 4 deliverable).

diff_manifest_policy.description: Path to the diff-manifest policy JSON; null or absent = the diff check is inactive.

machine_user.description: GitHub login that must post the integrity-review status; null or absent = local gate inactive.

require_signatures.description: true (default) = eval artifacts must be signed; the local key is created on first use, and signing refuses when ssh-keygen is unavailable. false opts out.
